newsitem.title: JAPAN: IBJ, LTCB shares fall to financial year lows.
newsitem.headline: IBJ, LTCB shares fall to financial year lows.

text.p: Shares in Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ) and Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) extended losses on Monday morning, touching their lowest levels for the 96/97 financial year.

IBJ's share price was down 30 yen at 1,390 yen at 0140 GMT, which is below its previous low for the financial year of 1,400. Volume of 1.138 million shares was the fifth heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
LTCB's shares were down four yen at 387 yen, also the low for the financial year.
